summary: Three churches (St. Pacificus Oratory is on the list but has no times). The cover prints only weekend Masses and Saturday Reconciliation; weekday Masses are weekly under R35 from the intentions lists of all five bulletins. First-Friday Adoration and the first-Saturday Mass are cited from older issues (R12). Open: the church for first-Saturday Confession, and whether SP's Tuesday Holy Face devotion is Adoration.
